notes:
A new Recolour tool.

**Drag over your markings and they change to whatever colour you have selected.** It works just like the eraser, but instead of removing what you pass over it recolours it: pen and highlighter strokes, pedal markings, bowings, note stamps and IPA symbols alike.

You'll find it as a magic wand just below the colour swatches, so the colour you pick is the colour it applies.

A few things worth knowing:

- It changes a whole stroke, the same way the eraser removes a whole stroke — touch any part of a line and all of it changes.
- A highlighter stays a highlighter, at its own thickness. Only the colour changes.
- One tap of Undo puts a whole sweep back, however many markings it caught.
- Passing over something that is already the right colour does nothing at all.
- Like the eraser, it only affects the ink layer you are currently viewing.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
